facts.fact: Teraco states it achieved an average annual Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) of 1.47 in 2024 across its data centres.
Teraco states its data centres used just 0.05 litres of water per kWh in 2024 and that it uses zero-water cooling solutions.

ZAF.note: Teraco is called a data centre operator, but the document does not state that it rents space, power or computing, nor any Tier or cloud region.
Only a Teraco education and digital inclusion spend; no rural access programme or rural/urban survey figures.
The document states no ownership, Tier or government hosting.
